audit_findings: rev0180 deep-audit correction surface is covered as an audit/refactor domain rather than a new substantive rights domain.
Fixture-suite reliance, context-pack visibility, registry scope truth, follow-through queue normalization, and research-tail compaction are now explicit audit-domain concerns.
Expression, persona, provenance, and social-graph rights remain inherited from rev0179 and require future current-law/protocol crosswalk refresh.
